title: Align TV rename hierarchy
summary: Align manual TV rename preview and apply behavior so show folder, season folder, and episode filename use the same normalized series title.
reason: Manual TV rename batches previously changed only the episode filename, which left mismatched show and season folders during rename preview and apply.
behavior_before: Manual TV rename preview/apply kept the file in its existing folder and only changed the episode filename, so the folder hierarchy could stay out of sync with the chosen show title.
behavior_after: Manual TV rename preview/apply now plans and executes aligned destinations like Show\Season 01\Show - S01E01 - Title.ext while keeping mutation boundaries backend-authored and undo-aware.
